items.title: Eddie Metz Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, October 3, 2015
items.q: I sent a note, I wrote an email to Danny telling him what an influence he is.

ctx.x: First side. Very first song. “Introduction” and then “Does Anybody Really Know What Time It Is” and then “Beginnings.” And then usually I’d go up and take the whole stack off and then flip it over. And it was question 67, 68. And listen. All those records. I loved them. And to this day I can still play them note for note. That’s how much I practiced. So I sent a note, I wrote an email to Danny telling him what an influence he is. And he says, “the next time you’re out near San Francisco give me a call and we’ll…
